about.title: About the Artist
about.text1: Roman Řehák is a Prague-based visual artist known for creating his entire oeuvre exclusively on a mobile phone — a technique called Phone Art.
about.text2: His surreal, dreamlike compositions, often featuring beautiful women, are printed on canvas and luxury carpets. His works are part of prestigious private collections, including those of Pierce Brosnan and Karel Gott.

technique.title: Technique
technique.text: Phone Art — an original technique in which the artist creates works exclusively using mobile applications. Since 2021, he has also been printing large-format works on special textile substrates (carpets).
